context: Two coworkers grumble about a paid expressway delay
purpose: Teach: 車両/経由/地下鉄/有料/観戦/一貫/掲げ/違和感

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: また有料道路で渋滞だってさ。事故車両が止まってるらしい。
lines.en: Apparently there's a jam on the toll road again. A vehicle from an accident is stopped.
lines.style: Frustrated office worker venting casually to a colleague after checking traffic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: えー、最悪。じゃあ私たち、新宿経由で地下鉄使ったほうが早そうですね。
lines.en: Ugh, the worst. Then it'd probably be faster for us to go via Shinjuku and take the subway.
lines.style: Practical female colleague suggesting an alternative route in a slightly resigned tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: だよな。あの会社、いつも「安全第一」って看板掲げてるくせに、対応おっそいんだよ。
lines.en: Right? That company always puts up a 'safety first' sign, but their response is so slow.
lines.style: Grumbling male coworker criticizing the highway company with mild sarcasm casually.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。料金は一貫して上がるばっかりなのに、サービスはなんか違和感ありますよね。
lines.en: Exactly. The tolls just keep consistently going up, but the service feels kind of off.
lines.style: Polite female agreement adding a pointed criticism about pricing versus service quality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今日は野球の観戦予定だったのに、これじゃ間に合わないかもな。
lines.en: I had plans to go watch a baseball game today, but at this rate I might not make it.
lines.style: Disappointed male sigh revealing personal weekend plans being ruined unexpectedly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あら、それは可哀想。今からでも地下鉄駅まで走れば、まだ間に合いますよ。
lines.en: Oh, that's a shame. If you run to the subway station now, you can still make it.
lines.style: Sympathetic female encouragement with a practical suggestion offered kindly to coworker.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうするわ。ありがとな、雪さん。
lines.style: Brief, grateful male reply showing relief and casual familiarity with coworker.
